subject: E4.1 BLOCKER: v2-compiled Math::BigInt infinitely recurses (tie STORE ↔ round_mode symbolic-ref write)
description:
Found s341 by the E4.1 rule-2 audit (plan §5a.2: every live `pipeline=v1` marker is pre-work).

SYMPTOM (measured): with the cond-my poison narrowing applied (branch `wip/s341-condmy-narrowing`, commit d0e8247), Math::BigInt stops falling back to v1 — and the v2-compiled module never terminates. `use Math::BigInt; Math::BigInt->new(...)` dies with SBCL "Binding stack exhausted"; perl-tests/pack.t goes from ~70 s to NOT FINISHING at a 600 s cap (sweep gate: LOST -5636, serial re-run confirms it is not load noise).

THE CYCLE (from the backtrace, deepest repeating pair):
  P-METHOD-CALL <boxed invocant, CLASS Math::BigInt> "round_mode"
  -> the round_mode body
  -> ${"${class}::round_mode"} = $m        # symbolic-ref write
  -> re-enters STORE
Math::BigInt (perl 5.40.3) has `sub STORE { $rnd_mode = (ref $_[0]) -> round_mode($_[1]) }` with `$rnd_mode` tied to the package (TIESCALAR/FETCH/STORE at lines 249-260), and round_mode's setter writes `${"${class}::round_mode"}` (line 293). Under v2 that write reaches the TIED cell, so STORE fires again; under real perl it does not. Note the invocant in the recursion frames is a p-box wrapping a p-box (CLASS Math::BigInt), i.e. `ref $_[0]` is not yielding a plain class-name string on the second turn — check that first.

WHY IT MATTERS: after E4.1 step 2 the Parser2 TODO becomes a hard error, so Math::BigInt cannot stay on v1. perl-tests/range.t, negate.t and pack.t all load it.

FIRST MEASUREMENTS TO TAKE (cheap):
- Does the symbolic-ref write `${"Math::BigInt::round_mode"} = "even"` reach the tied `$rnd_mode` cell under v2 but not v1? (probe both pipelines on a 10-line tie repro.)
- What does `ref $_[0]` return inside STORE under v2 vs v1 vs perl?
Fix at the layer the answer points at (CLAUDE.md 9a), then re-apply the wip branch and re-run: pack.t alone, then the cold sweep.
